lexicalDecisions.disposition: Select noun凪なぎ and gu-ending intransitive verb凪ぐなぐ as two distinct useful introductory weather supports. No existing spelling/reading identity candidate found. Preserve noun aliases和ぎ/和 in raw evidence without converting them into another kanji's reading or adding duplicate articles.

夜凪よなぎ, 朝凪あさなぎ and 夕凪ゆうなぎ are independently verified complete word/readings. 朝なぎ and夕なぎ carry search-only spelling flags; use ordinary recorded spellings朝凪/夕凪 for any recognition examples. No extra support articles or unsupported frequency claim needed.
逆凪さかなぎ means a spell/curse backfiring, not an ordinary weather antonym. Not selected; avoid manufacturing a general reverse-calm rule.

水凪鳥/水薙鳥みずなぎどり and大水凪鳥/大水薙鳥おおみずなぎどり concern birds, with usually-kana sense flags; katakana readings explicitly have re_nokanji. Complete records retained but not selected as proof of character-by-character calm meanings or a new regular reading.
初凪はつなぎ is the first/year-opening calm andべた凪べたなぎ dead/flat calm. Both complete families inspected; not necessary extra articles. Daijisen noun also attestsべた凪. No blanket rarity inference.
